name: roblox-max
description: Roblox-Max — Plataforma de jogos 3D voxel no navegador (WebGPU + WASM SIMD + Multithreading)

scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:shared && npm run wasm:plain && node tools/wasm-info.mjs
scripts.wasm:dbg: asc assembly/index.ts --outFile public/wasm/core.wasm --debug --enable simd --enable threads --importMemory --sharedMemory --maximumMemory 512 --runtime stub --exportRuntime
scripts.verify: npm run wasm && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:core && npx vite build
scripts.wasm:shared: asc assembly/index.ts --optimize --shrinkLevel 1 --noAssert --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --runtime stub --exportRuntime --importMemory --maximumMemory 512 --enable threads --sharedMemory --outFile public/wasm/core.wasm
scripts.wasm:plain: asc assembly/index.ts --optimize --shrinkLevel 1 --noAssert --enable simd --enable bulk-memory --runtime stub --exportRuntime --importMemory --maximumMemory 512 --outFile public/wasm/core-noshared.wasm
